translations.web: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.
translations.bsb: Save me from the mouth of the lion; at the horns of the wild oxen You have answered me!
translations.kjv: Save me from the lion's mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.
translations.asv: Save me from the lion's mouth; Yea, from the horns of the wild-oxen thou hast answered me.
